description: Changes one webhook (webhook_id from read webhooks): its url and/or events. events: public event names from read webhook_events (e.g. booking.created), or ["*"] for every event including ones added later. Shows the exact new url and events for your person's yes first (confirm step). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying.

confirm_token.description: From the preview, after your person said yes. Leave it out to get the preview.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: webhook_update
title: Change a webhook's address or events
